methodology.triton: fixed schedules, no autotuning; compiled runner and warmed JIT dispatch
methodology.tilelang_matched: native TVM-FFI runtime with exact Tensor cubin; ABI and launch checked
methodology.serialized: wall time for one allocating call plus stream synchronization; output destruction outside timer
methodology.batched: 20 queued allocating calls plus one synchronization, divided by 20

webgpu.operation_shapes_dtypes: identical to CUDA; upload copies of the same input tensors
webgpu.timing: allocating call plus queue completion; output release outside timer
webgpu.excluded: uploads/downloads, AOT compilation and cold pipeline creation
webgpu.scope: serialized comparison only; CUDA host batches and CUDA graphs retain CUDA providers
webgpu.gemm_schedule: 32x32 output tile, K=16, scalar FP32 accumulation
webgpu.attention_schedule: online softmax, query/key tiles 8x16, FP32 accumulators

validation.numerical_checks: same-input WebGPU outputs against eager at atol=.002/rtol=.02; all CUDA allocating and fixed graphs against eager; matched TileLang bitwise equal to Tensor; torch.compile Tensor/Inductor also checked

regression.method: Full suite with WebGPU enabled; its 52 CUDA opt-in skips were then selected and replayed with all CUDA opt-in flags enabled
